SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. REGIST. Station,
No. S. B. D. 1473.
Date July 23rd, 1930.
24 - 7 - 30.）
File No.

Subject (in full) Detention of British subject by Nantao Authorities

Made by D. S. Darters. Forwarded by L. Maguire C.I.

Sir,
At 7:50 p.m. 22-7-30, Mr. Dunlop, H. B. M. Consulate in
company with a Mr. Taylor, came to Station and reported that
Mr. Dewar, Kiangnan Docks, was being detained by the Nantao
Authorities. D. S. Darters and C.D.S. 111 accompanied Messrs
Dunlop and Taylor to Public Safety Bureau, Mr. Hwong, chief of
the latter Bureau was interviewed. It was ascertained that Mr.
Dewar was proceeding along Fang Zia Road in his m/car No. 6087
at 5:30 p.m. that date, and collided with a male Chinese who
had stepped of the side walk in front of oncoming car, Chinese
sustained injuries to legs and was removed to Hospital, his
condition is not serious. Mr. Dewar left the Bureau of Pub-
lic Safety at 9 p.m., after signing a bond guaranteeing to pay
Hospital expense and other claims if any, of injured person.

I, am Sir,
Yours obediently
（签名：E. E. Darters）
D. S. 33.

Senior Detective (C)
（签名：J. Dick）
D. D. O / "A".

156 (C. 783)
（批注手写字迹）
（签名：Lear）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与搜查登记站，
编号 S. B. D. 1473。
日期 1930年7月23日。
24 - 7 - 30。）
档案号。

事由（详述） 南市当局拘押英国臣民

呈报人 D. S. Darters。转呈人 L. Maguire 首席探员。

先生，
1930年7月22日下午7时50分，英国驻沪领事馆的邓禄普（Dunlop）先生偕同泰勒（Taylor）先生来到本警署，报告称江南船坞的迪尤尔（Dewar）先生正被南市当局拘押。警探 D. S. Darters 及刑事侦缉队第111号警员陪同邓禄普先生和泰勒先生前往公安局，会见了该局局长黄先生。经查悉，当日下午5时30分，迪尤尔先生驾驶其汽车（牌号6087）沿方斜路行驶，与一名从人行道走到迎面驶来车辆前方的中国男子发生碰撞，该中国男子腿部受伤，已被送往医院，伤势不重。迪尤尔先生于当晚9时离开公安局，此前已签署保证书，承诺支付伤者的住院费用及其他可能产生的索赔。

此致，
敬礼
（签名：E. E. Darters）
警探长 33号。

高级探员（C组）
（签名：J. Dick）
副总监 / “A”处。

156 (C. 783)
（批注手写字迹）
（签名：Lear）
